"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The threat from Iran's pursuit of nuclear weapons capability has worsened during the current administration.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A continuation of the current administration's engagement policy with Iran will lead to a nuclear cascade.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America must lead the effort to prevent Iran from building and possessing nuclear weapons capability, in solidarity with the international community.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The people of Iran seek peace and aspire to freedom.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The current regime in Iran is unworthy of the people of Iran.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Iranian regime exports terror and provided weapons that killed U.S. troops in Iraq.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The U.S. Senate unanimously called for elections in Iran that are free, fair, and meet international standards.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The U.S. Senate unanimously called for a representative and responsive democratic government in Iran that respects human rights, civil liberties, and the rule of law.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The next Republican President should unequivocally assert support for the Iranian people as they protest their despotic regime.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"All options should be retained in dealing with a situation that gravely threatens U.S. security, interests, and the safety of U.S. friends.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
